name: Scaffold New Vessel
description: Create directory structure and boilerplate for a new vessel. Generates package.json, types, index.ts entry point, and basic resolver structure.

variables.name: vesselDescription
variables.description: Short description of what this vessel does

variables.name: targetPath
variables.description: Path where vessel should be created (default: repos/<vesselName>)

variables.name: initialResolvers
variables.description: Comma-separated list of initial resolver types (e.g., 'file,memo')

prompt.template:
Create the directory structure for vessel {{vesselName}} at {{targetPath}}:

```
{{targetPath}}/
  src/
    resolvers/
    tools/
```

Use mkdir -p to create all directories.

Create a package.json for vessel {{vesselName}} at {{targetPath}}/package.json.

Vessel description: {{vesselDescription}}

## Requirements:

1. Use Bun as the runtime
2. Include these dependencies:
   - TypeScript (devDependency)
   - @types/bun (devDependency)
3. Include scripts:
   - start: bun run src/index.ts
   - dev: bun --watch run src/index.ts
   - typecheck: bun x tsc --noEmit
   - test: bun test
4. Set type: "module"
5. Set main: "src/index.ts"
6. Add vessel metadata in a "vessel" field:
   ```json
   "vessel": {
     "type": "autonomous",
     "capabilities": ["resolve"],
     "resolvers": [{{initialResolvers}}]
   }
   ```

Write the file using the write tool.

tasks.description: Generate index.ts entry point with HTTP server
